results.snippet:
The master's degree in Computer Vision & Data Science covers machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, mathematics and programming to give you a skillset to successfully find solutions to real-life problems. Working independently and in teams, your design, develop and test machine-learning algorithms, create and manage datasets, and then optimise these datasets to customer specifications. Taking responsibility for your own professional development, you develop the skills you need to [...] Learn from experts in the field
 Apply cutting-edge techniques on real-world projects of committed clients and partners
 Work in a lab with advanced tools and technologies, like your own VM in our high-performance computing cluster
 Graduate with a strong research and development background and high employability in various sectors
 The practical research approach of the programme is praised by the students, a year of project experience is gained [...] skills you need to guarantee your sustainable employability.

results.title: Master’s degrees | NHL Stenden university of applied sciences
results.snippet: The master's degrees are generally one-year programmes that help you develop your expertise further. You develop the knowledge you gained during your bachelor’s degree and explore a specific area in detail to become a professional specialist. As a master’s student at a university of applied sciences, you work closely with industry and will usually carry out research for a particular company or organisation, culminating in a thesis that presents your findings and draws conclusions supported by [...] A master’s degree at our university of applied sciences carries 60 credits and is equivalent to an EQF level 7/NLQF level 7. A master’s degree at a research university carries the same credits and is also equivalent to an EQF level 7, however, bachelor graduates from a university of applied sciences will need to do a pre-master's programme before they can start a research master’s. The pre-master's programme usually takes one academic year to complete and aims to give students the theoretical [...] the theoretical knowledge and academic skills needed for a research master’s programme.

results.title: Doing a master’s | NHL Stenden university of applied sciences
results.snippet:
# Doing a master’s

Once you’ve gained your bachelor’s degree, you could consider deepening your knowledge further and go on to study for a master’s. Postgraduate study means you get to focus on an area of your field you’re passionate about and it gives you a competitive edge in the job market. You can take a master’s at NHL Stenden or at another university of applied sciences or research university. [...] As you would expect from NHL Stenden, our programmes take a practical approach which means your thesis is not only a great experience for you but you also get to develop a working document for a real-life organisation.

Check out the master’s we offer at NHL Stenden.
